item.title: [Wed, Jun 24] Market on the Plaza
item.description:
🎫 KOTO 📍 Heritage Plaza, Mountain Village
Market on the Plaza is held each Wednesday, June 10 – September 9, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. in Heritage Plaza, the center of Mountain Village. Heritage Plaza is steps from the free gondola. Come enjoy local produce, original artisan creations, kid-friendly goods and more.
